# deps: tools: up ngrok to v3

Move the ngrok installation ([[DOT-130]]) to the v3 agent, per ngrok's [v2→v3 upgrade guide](https://ngrok.com/docs/guides/upgrade-v2-v3) and the [announcement](https://ngrok.com/next-generation). The binary was downloaded by the `Makefile` target `install-ngrok` from an `equinox.io` URL identified by a hash, so the bump meant changing that hash.
